title: A.e. degree-one multiplicative homogeneity forces h(v) = c·v near 1
statement: Let 0 < s ≤ 1 and let h : ℝ → ℝ be almost-everywhere strongly measurable on (1 − s, 1 + s). Assume that for every r ∈ ℝ with |r − 1| < s/4, h(ru) = r·h(u) for almost every u ∈ (1 − s/2, 1 + s/2). Then there is c ∈ ℝ with h(v) = c·v for almost every v ∈ (1 − s/8, 1 + s/8).
lean_statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (h : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < s → s ≤ 1 → AEStronglyMeasurable h (volume.restrict (Ioo (1 - s) (1 + s))) → (∀ r : ℝ, |r - 1| < s / 4 → ∀ᵐ u, u ∈ Ioo (1 - s / 2) (1 + s / 2) → h (r * u) = r * h u) → ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ᵐ v, v ∈ Ioo (1 - s / 8) (1 + s / 8) → h v = c * v
